steps.goal: Apply one lane of the refactor with no behavior change

steps.fan_out: one subtask per lane, ids apply-<lane>; use kind mechanical with the exact old and new text for pure renames

steps.goal: Confirm no behavior changed: old names gone, new names resolve, tests pass
